carrier_email.subject: Renewal Policy Questions for DEREK P HALSTEAD CONSTRUCTION CO INC
carrier_email.body:
Dear Underwriter,

I hope this message finds you well. We are reaching out regarding the renewal of DEREK P HALSTEAD CONSTRUCTION CO INC's Contractors Special Policy. There are a couple of questions we need clarification on:

1. CP 382 — NY Anti Arson Amendment: This form is present on the expiring policy but not on the renewal. Could you please confirm whether it was removed intentionally and, if so, why?

We kindly request your response by the expiry deadline of 09/24/2026.

Thank you for your assistance.

Best regards,
Account Manager (demo)
Fideon Demo Agency

client_letter.subject: Your Renewed Contractors Special Policy
client_letter.body:
Dear DEREK P HALSTEAD CONSTRUCTION CO INC,

Your Contractors Special Policy will renew on September 24, 2026, and your premium remains the same at $1,879.

Here are the key changes in your coverage:

- The NY Anti Arson Amendment (CP 382) has been removed from the policy.
- The Communicable Disease exclusion (DNCANY) has also been removed.

We are currently confirming with the insurer whether these exclusions were intended and will update you shortly.

Additionally, we recommend considering additional snow removal coverage and communicable disease coverage due to their exclusions in the current policy.

Please let us know if you have any questions or need further discussion on these points.

Thank you for your continued business.

Best regards,
Account Manager (demo)
Fideon Demo Agency
